title: HarnessOPD: Keeping the Behavioral Gains of a Stronger Harness Inside the Model
summary: A stronger search-agent harness can improve decisions, but the gains may vanish once those components are removed. HarnessOPD studies how to keep part of that advantage in the model parameters.

title: RG-CTO: Letting Failure Experience Influence the Next Attempt Selectively
summary: Failed traces should not be reused wholesale. RG-CTO estimates the reliability of negative experience before deciding how strongly it may shape generation.
